verdict.rationale: Polar's documented billing surfaces are checkout links/sessions, subscriptions, usage-based billing and order/payout management — there is no mention of a distinct 'invoice' object, invoice-sending workflow, or invoice-specific reminder cadence anywhere in the evidence; the dunning flow described applies to failed subscription charges, not standalone hosted invoices. Missing for 10: any documented 'invoice' entity/API, hosted invoice pages, or invoice-specific reminder scheduling.
